people.name: Ahasuerus
people.line: Persian Emperor (probably Xerxes I); husband of Esther

people.name: Esther
people.line: Jewish queen of Persia; saved her people from genocide.

translations.web: Then King Ahasuerus said to Esther the queen, “Who is he, and where is he who dared presume in his heart to do so?”
translations.bsb: Then King Xerxes spoke up and asked Queen Esther, “Who is this, and where is the one who would devise such a scheme?”
translations.kjv: Then the king Ahasuerus answered and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do
translations.asv: Then spake the king Ahasuerus and said unto Esther the queen, Who is he, and where is he, that durst presume in his heart to do so?
